# acecloud_security_group (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud security group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the security group. Must be 3-50 characters, alphanumeric with spaces, hyphens, and underscores.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the security group (0-255 characters). Only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, periods, commas, and spaces allowed.
- `rules` (Block List) Security group rules. Maximum 20 rules allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the security group.

<a id="nestedblock--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `direction` (String) Direction of the rule: 'ingress' or 'egress'.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol name (e.g. tcp, udp, icmp, ssh, http, https, rdp, mysql, dns, any).

Optional:

- `ethertype` (String) Ethernet type: 'IPv4' or 'IPv6'.
- `port_range_max` (Number) Maximum port number (1-65535).
- `port_range_min` (Number) Minimum port number (1-65535).
- `remote_group_id` (String) Remote security group UUID.
- `remote_ip_prefix` (String) Remote IP prefix in CIDR notation (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0).
